subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers adopt/review the open fork PR for this issue, or close it and request a fresh same-repository replacement?
rationale: The bug is still present, but the linked fork PR already contains the focused resolver and test shape, so a new automated fix lane would duplicate existing candidate work.

options.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
options.body: Refresh proof and checks for https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/544, then merge or port the focused resolver/test change if it still fits current main.

options.title: Request a fresh replacement
options.body: Close the fork PR and ask for a narrow same-repository PR with the same UI-only behavior and current Control UI proof.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
recommendation.body: Refresh proof and checks for https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/544, then merge or port the focused resolver/test change if it still fits current main.

likelyOwner.reason: The channel UI metadata refactor and current Control UI behavior are closest to this ownership trail.
